title: Published completed Koszul fiber computes the strict derived limit
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, A a commutative ring in universe u+1, d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and a : Fin r -> A any finite list, allowing r=0. Pull the actual completed coefficient sheaf to AsSmall X.ProEt with its induced topology, obtaining O. Let F be the derived equivalence induced by the explicit equivalence of module sheaves, and b the global sections obtained from the compatible-residue scalar map and pbcCompletedComparison. For every complex C of actual completed-coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], let Gamma(C) and gamma_C be the explicit transported signed Koszul fiber and its (u,0) unit [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. For every presentation D of the actual strict dual Koszul tensor tower and its total right derived inverse limit [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], there exists an isomorphism e : F(Q Gamma(C)) ≅ D.completion(F(Q C)) with F(Q gamma_C) followed by e equal to D.unit(F(Q C)). The site, ring, scalar map and equivalences are explicitly constructed. No generation, completeness, Cech assertion or mapping universal property is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Take the actual localization preimage P of F(Q C) and its prescribed realization. Apply the unit-compatible comparison between the published exterior Koszul fiber and the explicit tensor-dual Roos fiber at this P.

Use exact countable products of pro-etale module sheaves and transport exactness along the explicit module equivalence. Apply strictRoosDerivation on the lifted site to obtain RF and kappa with RF right derived from the ordinary-limit inclusion into the explicit Roos cone. Compose the canonical termwise-limit natural isomorphism with D.comparison to make D.inverseLimit right derived from the same ordinary limit functor. Right-derived uniqueness gives a normalized natural isomorphism rho : RF ≅ D.inverseLimit. Its defining unit equation is Q(roosι T) followed by kappa_T and rho_QT equals the termwise-limit isomorphism followed by D.comparison_T.

Compose the explicit fiber comparison with kappa_T, rho_QT, D.inverseLimit.mapIso(D.tensorFactors_P.symm), and D.completion.mapIso(realization). Substitute the explicit unit equation, combine the Q-maps, and cancel the inverse and hom of the canonical termwise-limit comparison. The remaining composite is definitionally D.unit(F(Q C)), because P and realization were the specified localization preimage and its canonical isomorphism.

theorem completed_fiber_strict_limit_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)) ℤ) :
    let O := completedCechRing X d
    let F := completedCechDerivedEquiv X d
    let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i)
    ∀ D : RingedKoszulLimitPresentation O r b,
      ∃ e : F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (intrinsicCompletionComplex X d r a C)) ≅
          D.completion.obj (F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
        F.functor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (intrinsicCompletionComplexUnit X d r a C)) ≫
            e.hom = D.unit (F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C))
